reason: My admin's spreadsheet is always a week or two behind and the receipts are already sitting in the Telegram group, so I'd burn the 40 free documents on old chat history. If it gets the messy building-supply nota right, $19 a month is less than what one double-paid nota costs me.
objection: My guys' handwritten nota are scrawled in Indonesian with crossed-out numbers. I doubt a bot reads them properly, and I don't believe it really catches a duplicate when the same nota gets re-photographed by a different worker. If I have to check every row anyway, my admin is still doing the job.
would_change_my_mind: If on the free trial it misreads more than a couple of the handwritten nota or misses a duplicate I know is in the archive, I cancel and stay with Excel.
